blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–TNT is tapping the services of Nick Hornsby as its temporary import for the resumption of the PBA Governors’ Cup while Rondae Hollis-Jefferson continues to prepare for his much-awaited return. Team manager Jojo Lastimosa said Hornsby is due to arrive Thursday evening to take the place of Hollis-Jefferson’s elder brother Rahlir, who saw action for four games. Lastimosa said Hornsby’s stint will depend on when Rondae is ready to once again don the TNT uniform after being out for a year with an Achilles injury. “He (Hornsby) will play until Rondae is ready,” Lastimosa told Inquirer.
